question: Was the WBG-2 negative primarily caused by the frozen corpus exposing only a subset of the eight hidden motifs per seed because motif identity used the low three bits of an LCG advanced four times per record, rather than by failure to identify motifs that were actually present?
hypothesis: Under the exact WBG-2 corpus generator and four frozen seeds, each training stream will expose exactly two of eight hidden motif IDs, each present motif will occur exactly 2048 times, six motif IDs will be absent per seed, the union across all four seeds will contain exactly four motif IDs, and the frozen selector will recover both motifs actually present in every seed. Thus the observed minimum 0.25 global true-motif recall is attributable to corpus support collapse plus an eight-slot selection budget, not failure to recover presented true motifs.
authority: research-only; diagnostic attribution only; no retuning or reinterpretation of WBG-2 thresholds

frozen_reuse.selector: byte-identical candidate filter, ranking, and eight-motif budget from WBG-2 R2

attribution_logic: Count only hidden motif IDs actually generated by the frozen training stream for each seed.
Compare selected motifs against both the global eight-motif set and the per-seed presented subset.
No WBG-2 result threshold is changed and WBG-2 remains a valid negative as preregistered.
A supported attribution means the negative is specifically explained by insufficient corpus support for six motifs per seed plus forced filling of an eight-slot motif budget.
A failed attribution means selector failure remains independently implicated and must be investigated without tuning WBG-2 post hoc.

classification_rules.supported: All sixteen frozen attribution thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: The corpus-support collapse is confirmed but presented-motif selector recall is below 1.0 or selected-count accounting differs from the frozen hypothesis.
classification_rules.negative: The corpus exposes materially broader motif support than hypothesized or the 0.25 recall cannot be explained by support collapse.
classification_rules.invalid: Frozen WBG-2 generator/selector identity, provenance, deterministic execution, or metric construction fails.

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not modify the WBG-2 corpus, seeds, selector, motif budget, definitions, metrics, or attribution thresholds after observing any attribution output.
